__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: An old man peering through ancient tomes rests here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Your guildmaster stands here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: mage guildmaster

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: An older man wrapped in purple, long-flowing robes meditates here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Your guildmaster stands here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: cleric guildmaster

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: A smaller man dressed in nothing but a tunic stands here waiting to train you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Your guildmaster stands here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: warrior guildmaster

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
A small elf dressed in black rests in the corner. As you enter he grabs
a knife an throws it at you. It lands the wall next to your left ear. We
will now begin, is all he says.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Your guildmaster stands here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: thief guildmaster

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This arabian beauty is obviously the daughter of some high ranking
official. As you attempt to sneak a peek under her veil you notice
a small moon-shaped birthmark on her left cheek.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A dark skinned, veiled woman greets you from behind the desk.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle receptionist

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He looks distracted as he pours five drinks at once without error.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: An old withered mage/bartender leans against the bar.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle bartender

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: You see the lead singer of the Lokettes lip synching to an old Zeppelin tune.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Brother John, lead singer for the Lokettes, stands on stage.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle john brother singer lead

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: A small skinny man rests here hoping to find a warm heart.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A panhandler rests here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle panhandler

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: A small skinny man rests here staring at your clothes.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A panhandler rests here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle panhandler

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: This poor soul seems down on his luck, perhaps you might spare a dime?
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A grubby beggar sits here in the filth.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle beggar

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: You see a large man in a white apron covered in flour from head to toe.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The baker stands here playing solitaire.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle baker

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: You see a half-elf sitting on a stool behind his counter.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The shopkeeper stands here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle shopkeeper

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
A large, well-fed shopkeeper, Nabil is adept at finding animals from all
parts of the world. He welcomes you warmly and offers to show you a pair
of priceless parrots.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Nabil, purveyor of exotic pets, is waiting to serve you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle nabil shopkeeper

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This middle-aged man looks over you with disdain and quickly suggests a new
wardrobe.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Ahkeem the tailor welcomes you to his store.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle ahkeem tailor

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: A tall slender elf stands before you smiling broadly.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Vera the veggie lady beams as you look over her stand.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle vera

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This stocky dwarf has a mad glint in his eye as he twirls his cleaver
carelessly into the air.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Butch the meatcutter stands here in his bloodied apron.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle butch

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Abdul returns your gaze with a steady eye. You quickly glance away under
his cold stare and place your order.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Abdul stands here, waiting to help you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle abdul armorer

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: You see a small dwarf with a large hump on his left shoulder.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Igor stands here doing... something.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle igor weaponsmith

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
You see a happy weather-worn face whose lines suggest many years on the
open sea. It is only through years of fishing that she is able to withstand
the smell that permeates the air.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Cassandra stands proudly over her selection.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle cassandra

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
A worried working dwarf stands here constantly making notes in his
book and looking at his watch.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The foreman stands here screaming at the workers.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle foreman man

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: A large sweaty looking man doesn't even return your glance.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A construction worker steadily works here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle construction worker

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The statue of Nati stands here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle statue

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Alander has been caught in the pose of casting a bolt of flame
down to some hapless victim.  He is dressed in the robes of a mage,
yet bears a sword carved into the glittering stone of his statue.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The statue of Alander stands here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle statue

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: A statue of a stocky, angry looking dwarf with a cigarette in his mouth.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The statue of Zump stands here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle statue

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
A tall, swirling dark stone formed this statue.  As you peer at him
longer, it seems to chuckle.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The statue of Nightshade stands here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle statue

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The statue of Satin, a small elven woman in mage robes, smiles serenely
and her eyes twinkle with gentle humour.  You take a step back in fear.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The statue of Satin stands here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle statue

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This statue poses the Lady of the Mountains in a simple robe, with
her long tresses sensibly pulled back from her smooth, smiling face.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The statue of Shandra stands here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle statue

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: A statue of Furey.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: There a statue of Furey standing here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle statue

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Landru is carved from shimmering polished hematite, and a smile seems
to flicker over his face.  A pair of dice are enclosed in one hand.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The statue of Landru stands here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle statue

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: You see nothing special...
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Aziz the Human Canon stands here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle aziz

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: You see nothing special...
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Mustafah the Human Robber stands here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle mustafah

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: You see nothing special...
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Fatima the Elven Invoker stands here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle fatima

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: You see nothing special...
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Kareem the Dwarven Mercenary stands here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle kareem

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This robust fellow returns your gaze with a smile, but something inside
tells you not to trust him very far.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A nomad merchant looks you over.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle nomad merchant

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The large half-orc quickly glances you over and returns to his duties.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A bodyguard sizes you up.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle bodyguard

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: This small child sees you looking at him and quickly looks away.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A skinny kid wanders around.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle kid thief

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Although seemingly dull witted, this hulking mass carries the huge
crates from the boats like so many lilies.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A strong dockworker walks by moving crates.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle dockworker

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The city's tax collector walks from store to store collecting the
Sultan's fee for living in his grand city.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A small man walks around scribbling in a notebook.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle man tax collector

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: You see nothing special.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Gord the Rogue stands here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle gord

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: You see nothing special.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Caramon the Knight stands here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle caramon

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: You see nothing special.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Raistlin, the Arch-Magician stands here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle raistlin

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: You see nothing special.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Curley GreenLeaf stands here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle curley greenleaf

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This sad case may have been an evangelist in another lifetime. He is known
to stand on corners and accost passers-by with his doomsday preaching.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A small grey-haired man walks around spouting gospel.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle man wandering prophet

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: You see a small starved cat.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A small harmless feline searches for food.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle alley cat feline

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: As you look up at this bird, you see the only thing it wants is a corpse.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A vulture circles above you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle vulture

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He seems intent on winning.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: An old man sits here playing chess.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle old man

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The huge hulking mass rises as someone asks him a question.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Conan the Librarian sits behind a desk.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle conan librarian

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: What you see before you is really a baby air elemental.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The wind kicks up some dust.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle dirt devil

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: A half snake half woman creature rears back to attack you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A lamia stands here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle lamia

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: This man looks like he could use a lot of rest.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A raggety dervish stands here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle dervish

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: You see a large wealthy man in red robes smiling at you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The Sultan rests here on his throne.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle sultan

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
You see a dark skinned beauty, wearing almost transparent silks and
light blue viel. Her loyalty to the sultan is unwavering.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A lovely, veiled harem girl stands here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle harem girl

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
You see a pathetic soul lying here. Some ex-nobleman that has fallen
out of grace with the Sultan.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The Jailer sleeps here, snoring loudly.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle jailer

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
You see a large man whose only duty is to protect the harem. He has been
castrated for the ladies' safety.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A eunuch stands here watching over the girls.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle eunuch

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
You see the most beautiful arabian girl that has ever met your eyes. Too
bad she's about to kill you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Nichole, the sultan's favorite girl rests on a mound of pillows.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle sultans favorite girl nichole

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: You see the all-knowing Allah.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Allah is here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle allah

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: This man looks like a mage/warrior, i wouldn't mess with him.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The Guard for the Guild of Mages stand here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle mage guildguard

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: This man looks like a cleric/warrior, I wouldn't mess with him.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The Guard for the Guild of Clerics stands here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle cleric guildguard

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The man looks like Conan's cousin, I wouldn't mess with him.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The Guard for the Guild of Warriors stands here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle warrior guildguard

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
You see a thief dressed all in black, he quickly stands as you enter
and steps to bar your way. You notice his hands resting on two sheafs.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The Guard for the Guild of theives stands here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle thief guildguard

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: You see a small boy running around the halls of the palace.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A servant boy is here running errands.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle servant boy

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: You see a trained fighter, ready to help those in need.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A guard stands here, protecting the innocent.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle sultans guard

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: You see a trained fighter, ready to defend the city.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A guard stands here, watching the gate.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle sultans guard

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: You see a large man skilled in hunting and killing.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The chief of the sultan's guard stands here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle sultans guard chief

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: You see an assassin down on his luck looking to be freelanced out.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A mercenary stands here waiting for a job.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle mercenary

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
You see the shipwright of New Thalos, waiting to make someone a boat. He
beams a smile at you through his beard as you walk in.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: An old captain rests here carving on a stick.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle shipwright captain

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
You see a large human, dripping in sweat, standing before you. He takes a
break from his swealtering work to bid you welcome.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The blacksmith stands here pumping air into his fire.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle blacksmith

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: You see one of the fine arabian beasts known about the land.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A horse stands here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle horse

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
You see a small round japanese man, with a camera around his neck and
a nose guard. He's looking at a small road map that he seems to be holding
upside down.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A tourist stands here looking lost.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle tourist

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: You see nothing special.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Shelbye stands here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle shelbye

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: A grey-brown reptillian creature with amber eyes stands before you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The cryohydra stands here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle cryohydra

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: A huge lizard like reptile with horns like a minotaur.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The minotaur lizard stands here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle giant minotaur lizard

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: A large two-headed hound barks at you viciously.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The death dog stands here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle dog death

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: A large fierce dapple skinned lion glares at you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The spotted lion stands here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle lion spotted

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: You see a large snake like reptile with more than a dozen legs.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A behir slithers on the ground.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle behir

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The chimera is still a mystery, better left unexplored. This creature has
the hindquarters of a goat, the forepaws of a lion and the body of a red
dragon.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A creature with three heads: lion, goat, and dragon stands here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle chimera

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
A beautiful creature with the body of a serpent and feathered wings the
color of the rainbow.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A couatl hovers here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle couatl

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The giant hornet hits you very hard!
You wish you wounds would stop BLEEDING so much!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The giant hornet hovers here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle giant hornet

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
A magnificant winged steed, this horse looks much like the arabian
thoroughbred you've seen in the stables.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The pegasus stands here, flexing its wings.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle pegasus

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
You see a very healthy female dressed in black, with long flowing
hair to match her outfit.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Elvira stands here mixing a love potion.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle elvira

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: You see a powerful but slighty insane mage.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Braheem stands here talking to the walls.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle braheem

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He does NOT look real happy that you have disturbed him.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The high priest rests here meditating, well he WAS meditating.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle high priest

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
You see one of the Royal Guards from Midgaard who seems to have gone
through some training.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: An Elite Royal Guard stands here smiling happily.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle royal guard elite

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
You see a really big guy here who seems to have lost an eye in one manner
or another.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A large half-orc with a patch over one eye pours beer behind the counter
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle patch bartender

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
You see a small hobbit with his feet kicked up on his desk waiting for
some sucker, um, customer to walk in his store.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Stitch, the leather dude reclines in his chair.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle stitch

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
A young elf stands here in dirt covered overalls. He seems to be weeding
his garden.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A small elf stands here tending the garden.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle gardener small elf

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
You see the largest horse you have ever seen before. Standing 10' at the
shoulder he breathes flame from his nostrils and leaps to protect
his love.
